description: Hotels, restaurants, laundries and other hospitality venues use ozonation to create a comfortable environment, eliminate odors and maintain high hygiene standards.

laundries.title: Commercial laundries
laundries.heroDesc: Cold-water washing with full disinfection. Up to 70% savings on energy and chemicals.
laundries.content:
Water ozonation in laundries is an advanced technology that significantly reduces detergent, hot water and energy use, and extends linen life and shortens wash time. Ozone dissolves in water and replaces part of the chemicals.

This is a fundamental change in washing: you replace harsh chemistry with something that works much better. So much better that water and time use can also be reduced.

Ozone is a strong oxidizer. With a small amount of alkali, cold water and detergent you can achieve cleaning and brightness equal to or better than chlorine and hot water.

The colder the water, the more stable ozone is and the longer it works. Above 95°C ozone loses effectiveness due to faster decay.
benefits: Treatment of delicate items without damage

economicEffects.title: Economic effects
economicEffects.comparisonTitle: Comparison of traditional and ozone washing

coldWater.title: Why cold water is more effective
coldWater.text: Washing quality depends on 4 factors: water temperature, chemicals, wash time and mechanical action. Using ozone, you can replace chemistry and temperature with a more effective solution.
items: Ozone creates hydroxyl radicals (OH) at pH 8 in cold water — the same as at high pH with hot water
The colder the water, the more stable ozone is and the longer it works
Above 95°C ozone loses effectiveness due to faster decay
Cold water does not damage fabric fibers — linen lasts longer
Absence of chlorine bleach with hot water prevents chemical reactions that damage fabric

process.title: Technological process
process.text: Ozone spontaneously decomposes to oxygen and does not require removal unlike traditional chemicals. This allows reducing the number of rinses by 20-40%.

items.title: Energy savings
items.description: 70-100% reduction in water heating costs. Complete washing in cold water.

items.title: Improved disinfection
items.description: Ozone effectively destroys viruses and bacteria even at low temperatures.

items.title: Softer linen
items.description: No chemicals remain in fibers. Linen becomes softer.

items.title: Better whitening
items.description: Strong oxidizing properties of ozone ensure brightness without chlorine.

ozoneClosets.title: Ozone cabinets for dry cleaners
ozoneClosets.desc: Dry cleaners use ozone cabinets — sealed chambers filled with high-concentration ozone. As a gas, ozone penetrates the densest fabrics and hard-to-reach areas.

steps.title: Treatment of delicate items
steps.description: Theatrical costumes, vintage, fur coats, leather jackets, motorcycle helmets, hockey gear. No mechanical action or heating — minimal risk of damage.

steps.title: Odor removal (deodorization)
steps.description: Fire smoke, ingrained tobacco smoke, biological odors, animal odors, mustiness. Ozone destroys the cause of odor at the molecular level.

steps.title: Disinfection
steps.description: Destroys cell membranes of bacteria, virus envelopes and fungal spores. Ideal for children's items and bedding.

steps.title: Monetization
steps.description: Service is sold as an additional option (upsell) or as a separate VIP service. Cycle cost is minimal.

equipment.title: Equipment selection
equipment.highlightText: Ozone generator capacity calculation depends on contamination volume, water quality and equipment specifications. A pilot project may be required for accurate selection.

limitations.title: Technology limitations
limitations.text: In some cases, a small amount of hot water will still need to be used. Cold water is not suitable for working with greasy stains (lipstick, shoe polish, ink) due to the physical nature of fat at low temperatures.
items: Heavily soiled linen with greasy stains requires a separate program with hot fill
Such loads usually make up a very small percentage of total volume
For the remaining 90%+ of linen, ozone washing in cold water is the optimal solution

roi.title: ROI and payback
items: 50-70% reduction in electricity bills (water heating is the main expense)
Reduced wash time — more cycles per day
